description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the database connection from password-based SQL Server authentication to Azure SQL Database with Managed Identity for passwordless connectivity.
tasks.reason: The application connects to SQL Server using plaintext credentials (DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD) hardcoded in the Dockerfile and read via environment variables. Replacing these with Azure Managed Identity eliminates credential exposure and aligns with Azure security best practices.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the JDBC connection in LoanConnectionFactory and LoanOriginationConfig from password-based SQL Server authentication to passwordless Azure Managed Identity authentication targeting Azure SQL Database. Remove the DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD environment variables and credential references. Ensure the connection URL and driver configuration are updated to support Managed Identity token-based auth. This is a plain Java EE servlet application (not Spring Boot) — adapt the migration accordingly.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: The project uses org.json:20140107, a 2014 release with known CVEs, and other potentially outdated dependencies. Remediating these ensures the application is secure before being deployed to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. Pay particular attention to org.json:json:20140107 which is an extremely old release with known vulnerabilities — upgrade to the latest stable version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded version, and any breaking change risk. Verify the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the ZavaLoanOriginationAPI to Azure Container Apps using the existing Dockerfile.
tasks.reason: The application needs to be deployed to Azure as part of the modernization goal. Azure Container Apps provides a managed serverless container platform with built-in Managed Identity support and scaling capabilities.
tasks.requirements: Deploy ZavaLoanOriginationAPI to Azure Container Apps using the existing Dockerfile (Gradle build → Tomcat 9 WAR). Configure Managed Identity on the container app to allow access to Azure SQL Database. Set environment variables for KYC_SERVICE_BASE_URL, RISK_SERVICE_BASE_URL, and LEDGER_SERVICE_BASE_URL to point to their respective Azure-hosted service endpoints. Expose port 8080.
